name: Exploitation of Remote Services
summary: Adversaries may exploit remote services of enterprise servers, workstations, or other resources to gain unauthorized access to internal systems once inside of a network. Adversaries may exploit remote services by taking advantage of a mobile device’s access to an internal enterprise network through local connectivity or through a Virtual Private Network (VPN). strategies.name: Detection of Exploitation of Remote Services

analytics.name: Analytic 1755
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Exploitation of Remote Services by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; Network Connection Creation via Android Enterprise Network Logging / Enterprise VPN [DevicePolicyManager.retrieveNetworkLogs(): DnsEvent / ConnectEvent; VPN flow metadata]. analytics.name: Analytic 1756
analytics.guidance: For iOS, detect Network Service Scanning by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed.
